## Purpose

Practice specifying CFA models in lavaan, and interpreting the results.

[**NOTE:** This is all fake data, specifically generated to highlight specific aspects of the lavaan model]{style="color:red;"}

Each scenario below gives you a research question, a description of the data,
and the sample covariance matrix. 

In this rlab, for each scenario:

1. Write the CFA model in lavaan syntax.
2. Fit the model and examine the global fit.
3. Interpret the results: the global fit, the standardized loadings, residual variances, and the factor correlation (if there is more than one factor).
4. Compare your results to the solutions.
5. Iterate until you get the same answers (or can make an argument for why yours are justified)

## Setup

```{r}
#| message: false
#| code-fold: false
library(tidyverse)
library(lavaan)
library(semPlot)
```

::: {.content-visible when-profile="teacher"}
```{r}
#| include: false
# Teacher-only helpers. They live in a teacher block so they are stripped
# from the student .qmd download.
global_fit <- function(fit) {
  round(fitMeasures(fit, c("chisq", "df", "pvalue", "cfi", "tli",
                           "rmsea", "srmr")), 3)
}
path_diagram <- function(fit) {
  semPaths(fit, what = "path", whatLabels = "std", style = "lisrel",
           layout = "tree", rotation = 1, residuals = TRUE,
           intercepts = FALSE, nCharNodes = 0, sizeMan = 8, sizeMan2 = 4,
           sizeLat = 9, edge.label.cex = 1, edge.color = "black",
           color = list(lat = "lightblue", man = "white"),
           mar = c(4, 4, 4, 4))
}
```
:::

## Default model

Every scenario below uses the same `lavaan()` call. The arguments are already
set up in the templates:

- `sample_cov`, `sample_nobs` -- the data are a covariance matrix and a sample size.
- `auto_var = TRUE` -- freely estimate the variances (factor variances & residual variances).
- `auto_fix_first = TRUE` -- the first loading of each factor is fixed to 1 to set the scale.
- `auto_cov_lv_x = TRUE` -- factors are allowed to covary.
- `bad_marker_crit = 0` -- keep lavaan from swapping out the first indicator as the marker.

What you need to write is the model.

# Scenario 1

**Research question.** Do four subtests from a district mathematics assessment
reflect a single underlying **math proficiency**?

**The data.** A district gave **N = 350** 8th graders an assessment with four
subtests. Scores are on a 0--100 scale.

| Variable | Subtest                    |
|----------|----------------------------|
| `arith`  | Arithmetic computation     |
| `frac`   | Fractions & ratios         |
| `word`   | Word problems              |
| `estim`  | Estimation                 |

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
v1 <- c("arith", "frac", "word", "estim")
cov1 <- matrix(c(
   91.064,  62.996,  50.171,  40.210,
   62.996,  98.691,  51.044,  42.335,
   50.171,  51.044,  75.403,  32.401,
   40.210,  42.335,  32.401,  58.991),
  nrow = 4, byrow = TRUE, dimnames = list(v1, v1))

cov1
```

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| code-fold: false
# YOUR TURN
model1 <- "
  # ...your model here...
"
fit1 <- lavaan(model1,
                sample_cov = cov1, sample_nobs = 350,
                auto_var = TRUE, auto_fix_first = TRUE,
                auto_cov_lv_x = TRUE, bad_marker_crit = 0)

summary(fit1, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)
```

::: {.content-visible when-profile="teacher"}
::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Model answer: lavaan code (teacher)"}
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: false
model1 <- "
  math =~ arith + frac + word + estim
"
fit1 <- lavaan(model1,
                sample_cov = cov1, sample_nobs = 350,
                auto_var = TRUE, auto_fix_first = TRUE,
                auto_cov_lv_x = TRUE, bad_marker_crit = 0)
```
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Model answer: lavaan output (teacher)"}
```{r}
#| code-fold: false
summary(fit1, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)
```
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Model answer: global fit (teacher)"}
```{r}
#| code-fold: false
global_fit(fit1)
```
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Model answer: path diagram (teacher)"}
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-align: center
path_diagram(fit1)
```
:::
:::

# Scenario 2

**Research question.** Are second-language (L2) learners' **motivation** to
learn English and their **anxiety** about using it two distinct, related
constructs?

**The data.** **N = 300** university English-as-a-foreign-language learners
answered six Likert items (1 = strongly disagree, 5 = strongly agree).

| Variable | Item                                                    |
|----------|---------------------------------------------------------|
| `m1`     | "I enjoy learning English"                              |
| `m2`     | "I want to become fluent in English"                    |
| `m3`     | "I put a lot of effort into my English classes"         |
| `a1`     | "I get nervous when I have to speak English in class"   |
| `a2`     | "I worry about making mistakes when I speak English"    |
| `a3`     | "I feel tense when I use English with native speakers"  |

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
v2 <- c("m1", "m2", "m3", "a1", "a2", "a3")
cov2 <- matrix(c(
    1.393,   0.756,   0.843,  -0.389,  -0.336,  -0.417,
    0.756,   0.999,   0.637,  -0.303,  -0.248,  -0.419,
    0.843,   0.637,   1.468,  -0.323,  -0.262,  -0.382,
   -0.389,  -0.303,  -0.323,   1.232,   0.589,   0.815,
   -0.336,  -0.248,  -0.262,   0.589,   0.856,   0.511,
   -0.417,  -0.419,  -0.382,   0.815,   0.511,   1.310),
  nrow = 6, byrow = TRUE, dimnames = list(v2, v2))

cov2
```

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| code-fold: false
# YOUR TURN
model2 <- "
  # ...your model here...
"
fit2 <- lavaan(model2,
                sample_cov = cov2, sample_nobs = 300,
                auto_var = TRUE, auto_fix_first = TRUE,
                auto_cov_lv_x = TRUE, bad_marker_crit = 0)

summary(fit2, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)
```

::: {.content-visible when-profile="teacher"}
::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Model answer: lavaan code (teacher)"}
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: false
model2 <- "
  motiv =~ m1 + m2 + m3
  anx   =~ a1 + a2 + a3
"
fit2 <- lavaan(model2,
                sample_cov = cov2, sample_nobs = 300,
                auto_var = TRUE, auto_fix_first = TRUE,
                auto_cov_lv_x = TRUE, bad_marker_crit = 0)
```
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Model answer: lavaan output (teacher)"}
```{r}
#| code-fold: false
summary(fit2, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)
```
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Model answer: global fit (teacher)"}
```{r}
#| code-fold: false
global_fit(fit2)
```
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Model answer: path diagram (teacher)"}
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-align: center
path_diagram(fit2)
```
:::
:::

# Scenario 3

**Research question.** Are **transformational leadership** and **team
psychological safety** two distinct, related constructs in work teams?

**The data.** A business-management researcher surveyed **N = 400** employees
about their manager and their team. All items are 1--5 agreement ratings, and
the matrix below is based on the responses as recorded. The researchers
developed the items for **leadership** (four items) and **safety** (three items).

| Variable | Item                                                        | Construct  |
|----------|-------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| `l1`     | "My manager communicates a clear vision for the team"       | Leadership |
| `l2`     | "My manager inspires me to do more than expected"           | Leadership |
| `l3`     | "My manager coaches me to develop my strengths"             | Leadership |
| `l4`     | "My manager is on-site most days"                           | Leadership |
| `s1`     | "Team members can bring up problems and tough issues"       | Safety     |
| `s2`     | "It is safe to take a risk on this team"                    | Safety     |
| `s3`     | "It is difficult to ask other members of this team for help"| Safety     |

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
v3 <- c("l1", "l2", "l3", "l4", "s1", "s2", "s3")
cov3 <- matrix(c(
    0.979,   0.617,   0.584,   0.187,   0.417,   0.328,  -0.372,
    0.617,   1.206,   0.610,   0.270,   0.399,   0.302,  -0.378,
    0.584,   0.610,   0.985,   0.151,   0.332,   0.233,  -0.355,
    0.187,   0.270,   0.151,   1.627,   0.196,   0.158,  -0.203,
    0.417,   0.399,   0.332,   0.196,   1.027,   0.580,  -0.615,
    0.328,   0.302,   0.233,   0.158,   0.580,   0.817,  -0.497,
   -0.372,  -0.378,  -0.355,  -0.203,  -0.615,  -0.497,   1.282),
  nrow = 7, byrow = TRUE, dimnames = list(v3, v3))

cov3
```

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| code-fold: false
# YOUR TURN
model3 <- "
  # ...your model here...
"
fit3 <- lavaan(model3,
                sample_cov = cov3, sample_nobs = 400,
                auto_var = TRUE, auto_fix_first = TRUE,
                auto_cov_lv_x = TRUE, bad_marker_crit = 0)

summary(fit3, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)
```

::: {.content-visible when-profile="teacher"}
::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Model answer: lavaan code (teacher)"}
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: false
model3 <- "
  lead =~ l1 + l2 + l3 + l4
  safe =~ s1 + s2 + s3
"
fit3 <- lavaan(model3,
                sample_cov = cov3, sample_nobs = 400,
                auto_var = TRUE, auto_fix_first = TRUE,
                auto_cov_lv_x = TRUE, bad_marker_crit = 0)
```
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Model answer: lavaan output (teacher)"}
```{r}

```
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Model answer: global fit (teacher)"}

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Model answer: path diagram (teacher)"}

# Scenario 4

**Research question.** Are **depressive symptoms** and **anxiety symptoms**
distinct, related dimensions of distress among clinic patients?

**The data.** A clinical psychologist collected self-report data from
**N = 450** outpatients. Each item asks how often the symptom bothered the
patient over the last two weeks (0 = not at all, 3 = nearly every day). The
items were written to measure **depressive symptoms** (four items) and
**anxiety symptoms** (four items).

| Variable    | Item                                       | Construct  |
|-------------|--------------------------------------------|------------|
| `sad`       | Feeling down or sad                        | Depression |
| `anhed`     | Little interest or pleasure in activities  | Depression |
| `hopeless`  | Feeling hopeless about the future          | Depression |
| `worthless` | Feeling worthless or like a failure        | Depression |
| `nervous`   | Feeling nervous, anxious, or on edge       | Anxiety    |
| `uncontrol` | Not being able to stop or control worrying | Anxiety    |
| `toomuch`   | Worrying too much about different things   | Anxiety    |
| `relax`     | Trouble relaxing                           | Anxiety    |

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
v4 <- c("sad", "anhed", "hopeless", "worthless", "nervous", "uncontrol", "toomuch", "relax")
cov4 <- matrix(c(
    0.635,   0.469,   0.385,   0.321,   0.217,   0.216,   0.214,   0.217,
    0.469,   0.873,   0.434,   0.366,   0.251,   0.203,   0.203,   0.196,
    0.385,   0.434,   0.622,   0.276,   0.234,   0.188,   0.180,   0.199,
    0.321,   0.366,   0.276,   0.466,   0.194,   0.155,   0.143,   0.168,
    0.217,   0.251,   0.234,   0.194,   0.630,   0.387,   0.367,   0.289,
    0.216,   0.203,   0.188,   0.155,   0.387,   0.857,   0.748,   0.326,
    0.214,   0.203,   0.180,   0.143,   0.367,   0.748,   0.815,   0.310,
    0.217,   0.196,   0.199,   0.168,   0.289,   0.326,   0.310,   0.585),
  nrow = 8, byrow = TRUE, dimnames = list(v4, v4))

cov4
```

**Step 1.** Fit the model implied by the research question.

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| code-fold: false
# YOUR TURN
model4 <- "
  # ...your model here...
"
fit4 <- lavaan(model4,
                sample_cov = cov4, sample_nobs = 450,
                auto_var = TRUE, auto_fix_first = TRUE,
                auto_cov_lv_x = TRUE, bad_marker_crit = 0)

summary(fit4, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)
```

**Step 2.** Use modification indices to examine the model. Run this on your model from Step 1:

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| code-fold: false
modindices(fit4, sort. = TRUE, minimum.value = 10)
```

**Step 3.** Decide whether to free a parameter based on the modification indices. If you do, write the revised model, refit it, and compare to Step 1.

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| code-fold: false
# YOUR TURN
model4b <- "
  # ...your revised model here...
"
fit4b <- lavaan(model4b,
                sample_cov = cov4, sample_nobs = 450,
                auto_var = TRUE, auto_fix_first = TRUE,
                auto_cov_lv_x = TRUE, bad_marker_crit = 0)

summary(fit4b, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)
```

::: {.content-visible when-profile="teacher"}
::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Model answer (Step 1): lavaan code (teacher)"}
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: false
model4 <- "
  dep =~ sad + anhed + hopeless + worthless
  anx =~ nervous + uncontrol + toomuch + relax
"
fit4 <- lavaan(model4,
                sample_cov = cov4, sample_nobs = 450,
                auto_var = TRUE, auto_fix_first = TRUE,
                auto_cov_lv_x = TRUE, bad_marker_crit = 0)
```
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Model answer (Step 1): lavaan output (teacher)"}
```{r}
#| code-fold: false
summary(fit4, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)
```
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Model answer (Step 1): global fit (teacher)"}
```{r}
#| code-fold: false
global_fit(fit4)
```
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Model answer (Step 1): path diagram (teacher)"}
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-align: center
path_diagram(fit4)
```
:::
:::

::: {.content-visible when-profile="teacher"}
::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Model answer: modification indices (teacher)"}
```{r}
#| code-fold: false
modindices(fit4, sort. = TRUE, minimum.value = 10)
```
:::
:::

::: {.content-visible when-profile="teacher"}
::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Model answer (Step 3, revised): lavaan code (teacher)"}
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: false

  dep =~ sad + anhed + hopeless + worthless
  anx =~ nervous + uncontrol + toomuch + relax
  uncontrol ~~ toomuch
"
fit4b <- lavaan(model4b,
                sample_cov = cov4, sample_nobs = 450,
                auto_var = TRUE, auto_fix_first = TRUE,
                auto_cov_lv_x = TRUE, bad_marker_crit = 0)
```
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Model answer (Step 3, revised): lavaan output (teacher)"}
```{r}

summary(fit4b, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)
```
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Model answer (Step 3, revised): global fit (teacher)"}
```{r}
#| code-fold: false
global_fit(fit4b)
```
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Model answer (Step 3, revised): path diagram (teacher)"}
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5
```
